title: Find and replace all TODO comments
brief: Change all TODO comments to FIXME throughout the file.
text:
# TODO: fix this
x = 1
# TODO: refactor later
y = 2
# normal comment

expect.text:
# FIXME: fix this
x = 1
# FIXME: refactor later
y = 2
# normal comment

why: A global substitution replaces all occurrences of the pattern in one command.
author: claude (daily)
